text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Flower's running is awesome! And that
speed!
She's nothing like how she was in
the Japanese
Oaks!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe someone in her classic
year ran so
well in the Sprinters Stakes...
She's amazing!
Flower's the best sprinter
there is!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: The best... sprinter!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I think there's a stage you'd shine even
brighter
on.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (You were right, Trainer...)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(This is where I can shine at my
brightest.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(If I can continue to make my mark here
and leave
incredible accomplishments
behind me...)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(Then people will call you "the best
trainer" too!)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Phew! I have to get faster!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Was that a declaration of rivalry I
just
heard?!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Bakushin O! Zephyr!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I'm currently working on my speed. As
long as I'm
fast enough, I can win at any
distance!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
So if you're gonna keep working on your
speed
into your senior year...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Then our relationship will go from mere
class rep
and student to rivals! Actually,
we already are
rivals!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I guess you're right!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Zephyr?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I thought this might happen. You two
choose to
stand directly in the path of
my wind.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
As such, I shall become a tempest thats
blasts
through any rival or wall in my
way.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Thank you? I think?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
And then Bakushin O, Zephyr, and I
promised to
race each other again!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While we walk home, Nishino Flower
recounts the
aftermath of the race with a
twinkle in her eye.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Mm-hmm! It was the best!
choice_data_list: You really had a great time, huh.
You really had a great time, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I was able to run with all my strength
today
because you believed in me.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Well, I think the biggest factor that led to my performance was your hard work, Trainer!
choice_data_list: It's the fruit of your own hard work.
It's the fruit of your own hard work.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
The old me would have been absolutely

exhausted after running that race.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
But thanks to how carefully you've
watched over
me, I'm perfectly fine.
Which is why I...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I, um...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Oh, um! I want to keep doing my best in
sprints
from here on out!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Currently, Daitaku Helios, a senior racer,
is
dominating in sprints and miles. She'll
be a tough
opponent to beat.
choice_data_list: Then shall we head down the sprint route?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I hear she's planning on running in the
Mile
Championship, and Yamanin
Zephyr seems intent
on doing the same.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, Nishino Flower's performance
today has
convinced me that sprints are
where she can shine
most radiantly. And
in that case...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ooh, a G1 race? I'd love to!
choice_data_list: How about taking on the Takamatsunomiya Kinen next?
Why don't we challenge the Takamatsunomiya Kinen next?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Well, I still get nervous about them...
But I also
get a lot more excited than I
used to!
choice_data_list: Are you used to G1 races already?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
You don't look scared about the idea
either,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Oh no, I'm not trying to tease you or
anything!
Um...
choice_data_list: Thank you for everything back then...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I was just thinking about how much
we've both
grown.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking forward to taking on a ton of
races
with you in my senior year too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, we set our sights on the

Takamatsunomiya Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Germinating Seeds..." There, the sign
looks
perfect.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Little poppies, I hope you'll bloom into
beautiful
flowers when spring comes
around.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I want to keep making Trainer proud, so
I'll do my
best as well!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(Phew... Today was such a great day. I
feel like I'm
going to have wonderful
dreams tonight. ♪)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Bourbon, is it all right if I turn off the
lights?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Sound asleep right on time, just
like
always. Good night.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ouch!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ow, my joints...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Maybe it's because I'm tired...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(I have to rest up well so I can perform
at my best
in the Takamatsunomiya
Kinen!)
